name: Paula Alvarez
biography: Paula Alvarez is an Actress and Producer whose dynamic portfolio spans a variety of genres, including drama, comedy, thrillers, crime, sci-fi, and fantasy. This amazing talent has a long list of television and film credits to her name. Her television credits include “Casados con Hijos,” “Lucifer,” “Snowfall,” and most recently, “The Rookie.” Her film credits include “Drive,” “The Last Sharknado: It’s About Time,” “The Devil Has a Name,” and “Cholo Zombies Monstro.
